A '''baked apple''' is the simple preparation of the [[apple]]. It heals {{Value|Baked Apple|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Baked Apple|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_apple.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Apples cook into baked apples in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Baked Apple|cook_time}}. Picking up an apple unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked apple takes {{Value|Baked Apple|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Baked Apple|heals}} and gives Regeneration {{Value|Baked Apple|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Baked Apple|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}.

Obtaining a baked apple unlocks [[Canned Apples|canned apples]] and the [[Apple Empanada|apple empanada]], which need it.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
